# PLY0036 — rebuild differs

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Message | `rebuild not deterministic: '<path>' differs at byte <offset>` |
| Severity | error |
| Exit code | 1 (EnvironmentError) |
| Strict promotion | no |
| Rule | `rebuild.determinism` |
| Area | infrastructure |
| Owning issue | INFRA-REBUILD |
| Status | active |
| Seen in | standard error of polypiler-tooling rebuild check and rebuild compare, one per difference between run 1 and a later run; a file that only one run wrote reads 'rebuild not deterministic: '\<path\>' exists only in run \<n\>' |

## Cause

The same generating command, run twice in fresh working directories with the same scrubbed
environment, wrote different output trees. Typical causes are iteration over a hash-ordered
collection, a timestamp or tick count in the output, an absolute path, or a file named after a fresh
GUID. A manifest (`polypiler.manifest.json`) is compared in its canonical JSON form, without the
members `tooling/ci/rebuild-ignore.yaml` lists; every other file is compared byte for byte.

## Example

```text
$ polypiler-tooling rebuild check --output out --input generator -- dotnet-sdk generator/polypiler-generator.dll timestamp {output}
run 1: c90989f09f23e1aefef01ca15c81cf5f53a82cdb5798cdcf7d3538c27d2f75ce
run 2: 6a8ca8f2bf774cb932e07641d4ef5ef8c81feeb5f57f5704794023c1f1bd2546
polypiler-tooling: error PLY0036: rebuild not deterministic: 'stamp.txt' differs at byte 7
```

## What to do

Open the named file of both runs at the named byte and find what produced it. Sort what is iterated,
take times and paths out of the output, or derive names from the input. Exempt content in
`tooling/ci/rebuild-ignore.yaml` only when it is documented as run-dependent, with its reason; an
entry that only makes a failing emitter pass is not one.
